import api
import queueing
import worker

def test_submit_default_batch_size():
    """Test submit with default batch_size=20"""
    enqueued = []
    def enqueue(p):
        enqueued.append(p)
        return p
    result = api.submit("owner1", enqueue)
    assert len(enqueued) == 1
    assert enqueued[0]["owner"] == "owner1"
    assert enqueued[0]["batch_size"] == 20

    """Test submit with custom batch_size"""
    enqueued = []
    def enqueue(p):
        enqueued.append(p)
        return p
    result = api.submit("owner2", enqueue, batch_size=50)
    assert len(enqueued) == 1
    assert enqueued[0]["owner"] == "owner2"
    assert enqueued[0]["batch_size"] == 50
